steps.title: Prepare fungal culture
steps.instruction: Transfer an agar plug containing fungal mycelia onto a PDA plate and incubate for 5 days at 25 °C.

steps.title: Assemble PCR reaction mix
steps.instruction: For each 20 µL reaction, add 0.5 µL of each primer (20 µM; ITS4, ITS5, EF1T, EF2T) to an AccuPower® Taq PCR Premix tube (Bioneer, cat. 20‑K‑2602), then add 19 µL nuclease‑free water (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. 7732‑18‑5) to dissolve the vacuum‑dried premix.

steps.title: Collect mycelium and add to mix
steps.instruction: Gently scratch the fungal culture with a pipette tip to collect a small amount of mycelium, transfer the mycelium into the PCR tube, vortex vigorously, and briefly centrifuge to bring the contents to the bottom.

steps.title: Perform heat‑shock cycles
steps.instruction: Subject the PCR tubes to three successive heat‑shock cycles:

substeps.instruction: Place tubes in a thermal cycler: 3 min at 95 °C, then cool to 25 °C.
Immediately transfer tubes to an ice bath for 1 min.
Vortex vigorously for 15 s, then chill on ice for 15 s.
Repeat the above three steps two more times (total of three cycles).
Centrifuge briefly to collect all liquid at the bottom before returning tubes to the thermal cycler.

steps.title: Run PCR thermal program
steps.instruction: Program the thermal cycler as follows:

substeps.instruction: Initial denaturation: 95 °C for 1 min.
40 cycles of:
Denaturation: 95 °C for 30 s.
Annealing: 56 °C for 1 min (adjust if primer Tm differs).
Extension: 72 °C for 1 min (adjust time for amplicon size).
Final extension: 72 °C for 3 min.
Hold: 4 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare 1.5 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Make a 1.5 % (w/v) agarose gel in 1× TAE buffer:

substeps.instruction: Weigh 2.25 g agarose powder (SeaKem® LE, Lonza, cat. 50004).
Dissolve in 150 mL 1× TAE buffer (microwave, avoid overboiling).
Add 7.5 µL RedSafe nucleic‑acid staining solution (iNtRON, cat. 21141) and mix.
Pour into a gel tray with a comb and allow to solidify at room temperature for 20–30 min.

steps.title: Load samples and run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Separate PCR products on the prepared gel:

substeps.instruction: Add 6× loading buffer (Takara, cat. 9156) to each PCR product.
Place the solidified gel in an electrophoresis chamber and submerge fully in 1× TAE buffer.
Load each sample and a 100 bp Plus DNA ladder (Bioneer, cat. D‑1035) into the wells.
Run at 100–120 V for 30–40 min (adjust voltage/time according to gel concentration and product size).
After running, remove the gel and visualize DNA bands under a UV transilluminator.

steps.title: Purify PCR product
steps.instruction: Use the MEGAquick‑spin™ Plus Total Fragment DNA Purification kit (iNtRON, cat. 17290) as follows:

substeps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL PCR product to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Add 250 µL agarose‑gel lysis buffer (provided with kit) and vortex to mix.
Place a spin column in a collection tube, transfer the mixture to the column, and centrifuge at 11,000 × g for 30 s; discard flow‑through.
Add 750 µL ethanol‑containing wash buffer (provided) to the column, centrifuge at 11,000 × g for 30 s; discard flow‑through.
Centrifuge the column at 13,500 × g for 3 min to dry the matrix.
Transfer the column to a new 1.5 mL tube, add 20–40 µL elution buffer (provided) to the membrane center, wait 3 min, then centrifuge at 13,500 × g for 1 min to elute DNA.

steps.title: Quantify and submit DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the purified DNA concentration with a NanoDrop 2000 and submit the samples to a sequencing service center.
